task: Fix HL perps executor showing $0 balance despite $149.80 in wallet

what_went_well: Two-tier scoring pipeline (filter=30 → exec=50) worked perfectly
Guard pipeline (R/R ratio, TP direction) caught bad trades correctly
ATOM LONG golden pocket signal was high quality (R/R=3.5x, score=61)
what_went_wrong: Exchange() initialized with wallet=None — could not sign any transactions
get_balance() used user_state() which returns $0 for Unified accounts
Bot spent hours generating perfect signals that could never execute
User deposited $150 that appeared 'lost' from bot's perspective
key_insights.root_cause: Hyperliquid Unified Account mode stores funds in spot clearinghouse, not perps margin. user_state() only queries perps margin. spot_user_state() is required for Unified accounts.
fix_applied: Exchange() now initialized with eth_account.Account.from_key(private_key) for transaction signing
get_balance() now tries spot_user_state() first (Unified), falls back to user_state() (Cross)
Balance response includes 'mode' field to distinguish Unified vs Cross

pattern_extracted.name: hyperliquid_unified_vs_cross_balance
pattern_extracted.description: Hyperliquid has two account modes: Unified and Cross. user_state() only works for Cross margin. For Unified accounts (default for new accounts), must use spot_user_state() to get the actual USDC balance.
pattern_extracted.rule: ALWAYS check spot_user_state() first when querying Hyperliquid balances. If it returns >0 USDC, use that. Only fall back to user_state() for Cross margin accounts.

anti_patterns.name: exchange_wallet_none
anti_patterns.description: Never initialize Exchange(wallet=None) — it silently prevents all transaction signing. Always pass the eth_account.Account object.

anti_patterns.name: single_balance_endpoint
anti_patterns.description: Don't assume a single API endpoint covers all account types. DEXes often have multiple clearinghouse modes.

user_feedback.comments: User was very upset — deposited $150 and bot showed $0. Critical trust issue.
